verses.original: הַהִיא֩ וּבָעֵ֣ת מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַגָּד֗וֹל הַשַּׂ֣ר יַעֲמֹ֨ד עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּךָ֒ הָעֹמֵד֮ וְהָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽהְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הַהִ֑יא הָעֵ֣ת הַהִיא֙ וּבָעֵ֤ת עַמְּךָ֔ כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃ יִמָּלֵ֣ט
verses.transliteration: ha·hî ū·ḇā·‘êṯ mî·ḵā·’êl hag·gā·ḏō·wl haś·śar ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- bə·nê ‘am·me·ḵā hā·‘ō·mêḏ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ‘êṯ ṣā·rāh ’ă·šer lō- nih·yə·ṯāh mih·yō·wṯ gō·w ‘aḏ ha·hî hā·‘êṯ ha·hî ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā kāl- han·nim·ṣā kā·ṯūḇ bas·sê·p̄er yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: At that time Michael the great prince who stands watch over your people . . . will rise up There will be a time of distress the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time But at that time your people everyone [whose name] is found written in the book will be delivered

verses.original: וְרַבִּ֕ים מִיְּשֵׁנֵ֥י עָפָ֖ר אַדְמַת־ יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה עוֹלָ֔ם לְחַיֵּ֣י וְאֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲרָפ֖וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃ס לְדִרְא֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: wə·rab·bîm mî·yə·šê·nê ‘ā·p̄ār ’aḏ·maṯ- yā·qî·ṣū ’êl·leh ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḥay·yê wə·’êl·leh la·ḥă·rā·p̄ō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏir·’ō·wn
verses.literal: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake some to everlasting life but others to shame [and] everlasting contempt

verses.original: וְהַ֨מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּזֹ֣הַר הָרָקִ֑יעַ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים וּמַצְדִּיקֵי֙ כַּכּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·maś·ki·lîm yaz·hi·rū kə·zō·har hā·rā·qî·a‘ hā·rab·bîm ū·maṣ·dî·qê kak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens and those who lead many to righteousness [will shine] like the stars forever and ever

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר עַד־ עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ רַבִּ֖ים יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ הַדָּֽעַת׃ וְתִרְבֶּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḏā·nî·yêl sə·ṯōm had·də·ḇā·rîm wa·ḥă·ṯōm has·sê·p̄er ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ qêṣ rab·bîm yə·šō·ṭə·ṭū had·dā·‘aṯ wə·ṯir·beh
verses.literal: But you Daniel shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end Many will roam to and fro and knowledge will increase

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים הֵ֙נָּה֙ אֶחָ֥ד לִשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֔ר וְאֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִשְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ḏā·nî·yêl wə·rā·’î·ṯî wə·hin·nêh šə·na·yim ’ă·ḥê·rîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm hên·nāh ’e·ḥāḏ liś·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr wə·’e·ḥāḏ hên·nāh liś·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: Then I Daniel looked and saw two others standing there one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָאִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִמַּ֖עַל לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹ֑ר מָתַ֖י עַד־ קֵ֥ץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·’îš lə·ḇūš hab·bad·dîm ’ă·šer mim·ma·‘al lə·mê·mê hay·’ōr mā·ṯay ‘aḏ- qêṣ hap·pə·lā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: One of them said to the man dressed in linen who was above the waters of the river How long until the fulfillment of these wonders

verses.original: הָאִ֣ישׁ׀ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּעַל֮ לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹר֒ וַיָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־ וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּחֵ֣י הָעוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְמוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָחֵ֗צִי יַד־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ עַם־ וּכְכַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš lə·ḇūš hab·bad·dîm ’ă·šer mim·ma·‘al lə·mê·mê hay·’ōr way·yā·rem yə·mî·nōw ū·śə·mō·lōw ’el- haš·šā·ma·yim wā·’eš·ma‘ ’eṯ- way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ bə·ḥê hā·‘ō·w·lām kî lə·mō·w·‘êḏ mō·w·‘ă·ḏîm wā·ḥê·ṣî yaḏ- qō·ḏeš ‘am- ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·wṯ nap·pêṣ ḵāl ’êl·leh tiḵ·le·nāh
verses.literal: And the man dressed in linen who was above the waters of the river raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever saying It will be for a time [and] times and half a time When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered all these things will be completed

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲדֹנִ֕י מָ֥ה אַחֲרִ֖ית אֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.literal: I heard but I did not understand So I asked My lord what will be the outcome of these [things]

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר כִּֽי־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים עַד־ עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ dā·nî·yêl way·yō·mer kî- had·də·ḇā·rîm sə·ṯu·mîm wa·ḥă·ṯu·mîm ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ qêṣ
verses.literal: Go on your way Daniel he replied for the words [are] closed up and sealed until the time of the end

verses.original: רַבִּ֔ים יִ֠תְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְהִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ וְלֹ֥א כָּל־ רְשָׁעִ֑ים יָבִ֖ינוּ וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm yiṯ·bā·ră·rū wə·yiṯ·lab·bə·nū wə·yiṣ·ṣā·rə·p̄ū rə·šā·‘îm wə·hir·šî·‘ū wə·lō kāl- rə·šā·‘îm yā·ḇî·nū wə·ham·maś·ki·lîm yā·ḇî·nū
verses.literal: Many will be purified made spotless and refined but the wicked will continue to act wickedly None . . . of the wicked will understand but the wise will understand

verses.original: וּמֵעֵת֙ הַתָּמִ֔יד הוּסַ֣ר שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם וְלָתֵ֖ת אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃ יָמִ֕ים
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘êṯ hat·tā·mîḏ hū·sar šiq·qūṣ šō·mêm wə·lā·ṯêṯ ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim wə·ṯiš·‘îm yā·mîm
verses.literal: And from the time the daily [sacrifice] is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up there will be 1,290 . . . . . . days

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽמְחַכֶּ֖ה וְיַגִּ֑יעַ אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ לְיָמִ֕ים
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ham·ḥak·keh wə·yag·gî·a‘ ’e·lep̄ šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh lə·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Blessed [is] he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 . . . . . . . . . . . . days

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַקֵּ֑ץ וְתָנ֛וּחַ וְתַעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh lêḵ laq·qêṣ wə·ṯā·nū·aḥ wə·ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ lə·ḡō·rā·lə·ḵā lə·qêṣ hay·yā·mîn
verses.literal: But as for you go on your way until the end You will rest and then you will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days
